programme.desc: The second programme focuses on the 18th century, a period that heralded the greatest blossoming of Scottish artistry in its history. programme.desc: S12 E06 — Yucatán Meats Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S11 E04 — Bread Masters Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S12 E08 — Mayan Gateway To The Underworld No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S10 E03 — Jalisco Classics In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S09 E01 — Tucson: Gateway to Sonora In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour.
programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table

programme.desc: S05 E02 — Bring Your Own Lunch These handheld lunches for work or school are easy on the wallet and customizable for the whole family.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S05 E08 — The Future is Flavor Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that'll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S05 E04 — How Do You Like Them Apples Apples aren't just good for keeping the doctor away. Frankie demonstrates how to make the most of this beloved, everyday fruit, from sweet treats to savory meals. There's a whole world of apples to dive into, especially while they're in season.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S05 E09 — Pantry Pasta It's no secret that pasta is Frankie's favorite; he's serving it up all night without even opening his fridge.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S05 E03 — Salad Salad Salad Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Let's Play Ball No matter who you're rooting for, savor these ballpark favorites while beating those major league prices.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S06 E07 — Piece Of The Pie There may be infinite ways to define pie, but the only math that matters is what makes these sweet and savory dishes fit the bill. In true Struggle Style, Frankie rolls out his best tips and tricks for enjoying hassle-free, cost-friendly pies.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S06 E01 — Citrus Sunshine Winter citrus is here to brighten up your day. Frankie is fixing up some light, zesty, and affordable recipes to add a little seasonal sunshine to your plate.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S06 E02 — Suppertime Superstar From casual weeknights to special occasions, be the star of the dinnertime with these crowd-pleasing meals.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S06 E10 — Cry Me An Allium River Frankie takes on his longtime frenemy, the onion, and all its powerful relatives. There might be a few tears shed along the way, but they are well worth the delicious and flavorful results, from sweet buttery leeks to the ultimate onion masterpiece.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S06 E06 — I Need To Eat Right Now At the end of a long, hectic day, when you need dinner in a pinch, Frankie unlocks his not-so-secret formula for whipping up quick and easy meals, using minimal ingredients that will satisfy your cravings and feed the family in a flash.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S06 E05 — Fancy Pants Pasta Treat yourself to a five-star pasta dinner, as Frankie cooks his signature dishes with showstopping sauces.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Carne Adovada Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Grilled Steak Salad and Italian-style Lamb Chops Jamie shares his perfect Steak & Chargrilled Salad, a Chicken Caesar Salad with an upgrade on the bars, Italia-inspired Sizzling Lamb Lollipops and his delicious Whole Barbecue Fish & Ratatouille to upgrade your grill skills!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Grilled Fish Tacos and a Veggie Pancake For the ultimate BBQ experience, Jamie cooks a Butterflied Leg of Lamb, his Spiced Chicken Kebabs and creamy butter sauce perfect for a party, followed by Grilled Fish Tacos and Jamie's Tear 'n' Share Veggie Pancake ready to feed a crowd.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Sesame Chicken Burger and Surf & Turf Mixed Grill Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread; and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ

Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Autumn's Harvest: Roast Chicken and Tarte Tatin Jamie cooks a roast chicken with eggplant, bakes feta with figs & prosciutto, and creates a runner bean stew with fish. He shares tips for storing berries and chiles, finishing with a stunning pear tarte tatin.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S10 E03 — Chicken Pizza Ditch the dough. Chef Frankie Celenza makes a protein-packed pizza the whole family will love. This is chicken pizza like you've never tried at home - until now.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E13 — Whole Chicken Paprikash Chef Frankie Celenza stretches one whole chicken and a pack of ramen to make a rich and warm Chicken Paprikash dish, swapping egg noodles for buttered ramen and using the seasoning packet to boost the sauce.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E12 — Fancy Fish Filet Sandwich Chef Frankie Celenza levels up a drive-thru classic fish filet sandwich with ultra-crispy fried cod, homemade tartar sauce and pimento cheese. Plus, five reasons not to toss your leftover pickle brine.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E10 — Pub-Style Pie A comforting pub classic made easy. Chef Frankie Celenza turns inexpensive chuck roast and rich stout beer into a hearty British Beef and Ale Pie with a waterproof hot water crust. Plus, how to cook once for comfort food twice.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E09 — Ramen Croutons and Napa Cabbage Chef Frankie Celenza elevates a packet of ramen for a hearty yet dainty salad. The dish features crispy croutons atop a crunchy napa cabbage with fruit, nuts and leftover chicken. Plus, a reminder to make your own salad dressing. You can do it!
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E06 — Meatloaf More Than Once Chef Frankie Celenza turns 2 lbs of ground beef into a moist meatloaf and pan-seared meatloaf burgers with slaw. Plus, a tip on storing burgers that your future self will thank you for.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E01 — BEC for One, For Many Make the perfect bacon, egg and cheese sandwich for yourself or for a crowd with Chef Frankie Celenza's tips on homemade condiments and the secret to crispy bacon every time.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E16 — Half Homemade Matzo Ball Soup Chef Frankie Celenza makes cozy, comforting Matzo Ball Soup entirely from scratch, almost. Rotisserie chicken is the struggle hero of this classic recipe, searing the skin to create rich schmaltz. Plus homemade matzo balls that float and never sink.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S10 E17 — A Big Braised Chuck Roast Sandwich aka The Wichita Have you ever wondered what's the difference between a Philly Cheesesteak and a French Dip Sandwich? Chef Frankie Celenza takes a bite out of both and invents a whole new, affordable, delicious sandwich: The Wichita!
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Carne Adovada Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E15 — Pizzapalooza Chef Dale Talde grills a Chicago-style pie, pepperoni pizza pocket, chicken wings, and a zesty grilled Caesar.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E04 — Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Art of Open Fire Cooking Chef Dale goes back to the roots of cooking, building a grill over an open fire to serve up a variety of dishes, including whole smoked chicken and fish, roasted cauliflower, a sweet and tangy grilled pineapple s'more dessert.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E14 — Family-Friendly BBQ Chef Dale Talde creates a tasty menu that kids & parents alike will love! Apple pancakes with coconut brown butter syrup, grilled cheese & tomato soup, cheesy chicken parm, and a sticky s'mores dessert round out the full day of deliciousness.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E02 — It's Taco Time Tacos are the way to Chef Dale's heart, and he's grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S05 E05 — Kabob-alicious Dale skewers ribeye, salmon, smoky eggplant dip, and grilled peaches. Food on sticks never tasted better!

programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E08 — Tailgate Surf-and-Turf Po'Boy Sandwiches Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E09 — Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E04 — Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Carne Adovada Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E03 — A Whole Roasted Hog For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S22 E22 — Home Profits Snafu!; Can You Find the Scam? After making a down payment on a home in her cousin's name, a woman expects to see her money returned when he sells it. The judge suspects government fraud after hearing a bad-check story about Social Security and a 17-year-old gambling problem.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E23 — You Can't Take the Fireplace With You!; Best Friend Split After Party Swipe! A woman wants her ex-fiance to pay for a credit card bill and the fireplace they once used in their shared home. After a man's car is sideswiped at a party, his best friend denies liability.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E24 — Pekingese Chihuahua Mating Mess; Camper vs. Computer Neighbours disagree completely as to the terms of breeding and stud fees after their beloved pets hook up and start a family. A man being sued for a $3,200 computer claims his ex said that if he paid for half of a camper, the computer would be free.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E25 — I Will Never Help Another Soul Again!; Load a Bowl of Cannabis Vendetta?!; Oops! Lost My Checkbook! An ex-friend sues a woman for a loan and missing property. Medicinal pot smokers point the finger at each other when their growing venture falls apart. A man fails to repay his girlfriend's aunt for a loan because, he says, he lost his check book.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E26 — Robbed by Lover While in Prison?! An ex-convict claims that, while he served time, his girlfriend stole from his bank account. She says the money was spent on him.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E21 — Teen Joyriders Busted by Police!; Uninsured Boyfriend Destroys Car?! A woman fights to keep her son's police record clean so he can play sports, and she disputes $4000 in restitution with another mum. A woman sues her daughter for the cost of a tow bill after her unlicensed boyfriend totals the vehicle she sold her.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E93 — Parents Sue Son; Shoes on Fire! Parents sue a young man for totalling his sister's car. A teen sues her former friend's girlfriend for setting fire to her shoes and damaging her bed.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E97 — Teen Driver Destruction; Harley Freeloader? A teen's boss says she drove his truck without permission and destroyed the engine. Ex-lovers fight over a motorcycle, trashed belongings, speeding with expired tags and money.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E102 — When Service Dogs Attack!; Man vs. Car A man sues for medical and vet bills, claiming his neighbour's service dog attacked him and his dog. A man sues a jaywalker for kicking his taillight.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E124 — Online Whirlwind Romance; No Good Deed! Young lovers who met online fight over assault, a laptop and credit-card charges. Former friends feud over a totalled car.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S4 E10 — Episode 10 A large quantity of tobacco causes a stir at Auckland airport. During a routine check of a private yacht, one of the drug-sniffing dogs detects something, arousing the interest of border officials.
programme.title: Border Patrol

programme.desc: S5 E1 — Episode 1 A passenger hides $1 million worth of methamphetamines in an airport bathroom. Meanwhile, first-time visitors to New Zealand are getting more than a stamp in their passports.
programme.title: Border Patrol

programme.desc: Body In The Bag Geoffrey Wansell explores how Cardiff killer Malcolm Green murdered twice - walking free after his first killing, only to strike again. He now serves a whole life tariff.
programme.title: UK Crime Files

programme.desc: The Gay Slayer After hearing the confessions of Colin Ireland, who murdered five men in two weeks, detectives have been haunted by his calculating detail.
programme.title: UK Crime Files

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Armed and Deadly Oklahoma retirees Gary and Linda Haas are murdered in New Mexico. A fingerprint points detectives towards a jailbreak and four desperate fugitives.
programme.title: Deadly Destinations

programme.desc: S1 E3 — A Dangerous Game There's danger on the track at the year's biggest race, Mugello. Franco battles to focus on his goal of 'Rookie of the Year' while around him his team implodes.
programme.title: Morbidelli Rising

programme.title: Storm of Suspicion

programme.desc: S7 E10 — Episode 10 A father with two young children calls for help, then fights for his life when what appeared to be a sore throat worsens and becomes sepsis. Plus, a historic home and restaurant is engulfed in flames, but a young man sleeps through the fire alarm.
programme.title: Close Calls: On Camera

programme.desc: S7 E11 — Episode 11 Pensioner Brian tells how he became trapped up to his neck in a slurry pit until hero, and former policeman Matt, came to his rescue. Plus a mum and her young daughter describe the moment their car plunged off the road into a water-filled ditch.
programme.title: Close Calls: On Camera

programme.desc: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.
programme.title: Teleshopping

programme.desc: S24 E191 — Attack of the Great Dane Puppy?!; This Isn't Going to Go Well for You! A woman sues her ex for an unpaid loan and damages, he counter-sues and says she left her daughter behind.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S25 E15 — Disneyland and the 25-Million Dollar Payout? Couple sues ex-friend for scamming them on Disneyland tickets, garage fees, and fraud.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S25 E16 — My Grandfather Abused Me?! Plaintiff Cassandra Currier sues her grandfather, Michael Walker, for assault and illegal eviction. Seeking protection from further hostility, she also requests a restraining order.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S24 E194 — Vandalism Admission Plaintiff Magen Spape is suing father of her children for breaking a lease, and breaking an iPhone.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E85 — Boys Just Wanna Have Guns; Minor Car Collision A man says his daughter's boyfriend stole a gun from his home and owes him for a polygraph test. Then, a defendant blames a plaintiff's teen daughter for a car accident.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E91 — Boxer Boo Boo; Ex-Lover Association Fight A dog sprains its foot. A man wants his ex to repay a debt.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E90 — Dud Truck Divides Siblings; Man Attacked by His Own Pit Bull; Internet Snafu A woman says the truck her brother sold her is a lemon and refuses to pay for it; after his own pit bull attacks him, a man blames his neighbour's dog for upsetting it; a computer owner sues a technician for causing her photos and documents to vanish.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E87 — Bike Bang-Up; Assault and Rent A neighbour accuses a 12-year-old of damaging a truck. A man tries to get payback from his ex-boyfriend, who accuses him of assault.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E70 — Teen Child Support Woes!; Baby Car Seat Slip-Up! A man sues his unemployed ex for her share of their child's extracurricular activities and orthodontic bills; a mother puts her toddler in the wrong kind of car seat, causing her friend to get a ticket.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E71 — Innocent Onlooker Steps Up!; Officer Byrd Nudged by a 13-Year-Old! An eyewitness tells of a car crash; a teen demonstrates how he pushed another child on the playground.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E72 — Hostile Work Environment?; Trampoline Park Accident! A homeless couple accuse a former friend of cheating them out of pay and harassing them on the job; a teen accidentally stabs a co-worker's phone with a pen.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E27 — Deliberate Finger Slam?!; I'm Not Paying for a Dry Wig! A man says his roommate broke the lock on his door four times, while she claims he assaulted her as she tried to climb in a window. A stylist demands payment for the wig she created, but her client claims it was over-processed and incomplete.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E28 — Husky Attacks Bichon Frise?!; Sick Girlfriend Payback! When a dog sitter makes an ill-fated decision to visit a locale with a dangerous, large dog, a bruised spine and more than $7000 in vet bills soon follow. A divorced mother of three takes in her female lover only to sue her for rent.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E29 — You Get What You Paint For!; Don't Fence Me In! After getting a deal on a paint job, a woman sues the contractor for shoddy work, mental anguish and legal fees. A 12-year feud between neighbours intensifies when a woman refuses to spend thousands of dollars to repair a shared fence's foundation.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S22 E20 — Childcare Payback!; Expensive Phone -- Throwaway Boyfriend?!; Telephone Pole Crash! A daycare provider sues a couple for unpaid childcare fees for their two children. programme.desc: Mecze Bayernu z Borussią Dortmund od lat nadają ton rywalizacji o mistrzostwo Niemiec. Nie inaczej będzie z Der Klassikerem numer 141, który zostanie rozegrany w ramach ósmej kolejki kampanii 2026/27. Bawarczycy i piłkarze BVB do połowy października szli łeb w łeb w wyścigu o tytuł. Ich bezpośrednie starcie na Allianz Arenie najprawdopodobniej zadecyduje o tym, który z gigantów zostanie samodzielnym liderem Bundesligi. Podopieczni Vincenta Kompany'ego mają nad Dortmundczykami przewagę psychologiczną. Znajdują się bowiem na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu nad Borussią. Ostatnim razem pokonali ją 2:1 w sierpniowym meczu o Superpuchar Niemiec.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: FC Bayern Monachium - Borussia Dortmund

programme.title: Legendy Bundesligi

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Borussii Dortmund

programme.desc: Barwy klubu FC Schalke 04 Gelsenkirchhen reprezentowało wielu klasowych snajperów, m.in. Klaus Fischer, Klaas-Jan Huntelaar, Ebbe Sand, Kevin Kuranyi. W programie widzowie zobaczą najlepsze gole w historii drużyny z Gelsenkirchen.
programme.title: Najlepsze gole Schalke 04

programme.desc: Paryżanie rozpoczęli październik dopiero na szóstym miejscu w tabeli Ligue 1. W dziewiątej kolejce czeka ich wyjazdowy mecz z najsłabszym zespołem początkowej fazy sezonu, który w sześciu pierwszych spotkaniach ligowych wywalczył zaledwie dwa punkty. Piłkarze PSG liczą na piątą z rzędu wygraną z Le Havre.
programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Le Havre AC - Paris Saint-Germain

programme.desc: Stuttgart jest cieniem drużyny, która ukończyła poprzedni sezon Bundesligi na czwartym miejscu w tabeli. Die Roten balansują tuż nad strefą spadkową, mając na koncie aż pięć porażek w siedmiu kolejkach. Biorąc pod uwagę okoliczności, ich zwycięstwo nad Bayerem Leverkusen wydaje się mało prawdopodobnym scenariuszem.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Bayer 04 Leverkusen - VfB Stuttgart

programme.desc: Rossoneri znaleźli patent na derbowego rywala. Mogą się poszczycić bilansem pięciu wygranych i trzech remisów w ośmiu ostatnich konfrontacjach z Interem. Podrażnieni Nerazzurri mają świadomość, że muszą zrobić wszystko, co w ich mocy, by przerwać błędne koło i odzyskać panowanie w stolicy Lombardii. W hicie dziesiątej kolejki na pewno zmotywuje ich do tego spory ścisk panujący na szczycie tabeli Serie A. Jeśli Piotr Zieliński i spółka nie pokonają Milanu, ucieszą piłkarzy Lazio i Romy, którzy na obecnym etapie sezonu wyglądają na ich głównych konkurentów w wyścigu o scudetto.
programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Milan - Inter Mediolan

Zespół z Lazurowego Wybrzeża do fatalnym początku sezonu wstał z kolan i pnie się w górę tabeli. Obecnie na swoim koncie ma już 11 punktów i próbuje włączyć się do walki o europejskie puchary.

programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.

W 10. kolejce Paris Saint-Germain podejmie ESTAC Troyes. Przyjezdni odnieśli ostatnio drugie ligowe zwycięstwo w tym sezonie, pokonując 2:0 Le Mans FC.

programme.desc: Nicola Zalewski cieszy się umiarkowanym zaufaniem Maurizio Sarriego. Jednakże, gdy już dostaje od trenera szansę, z reguły nie zawodzi. Przekonamy się, czy pomoże Atalancie zdobyć punkty w starciu z Parmą.
programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Atalanta BC - Parma Calcio 1913

programme.desc: Obie ekipy mierzyły się kilka dni wcześniej w ramach Pucharu Niemiec. Wówczas 1. FC Köln zaprezentowało się zdecydowanie lepiej i wygrało aż 5:0. Union Berlin z pewnością będzie chciał zrewanżować się przed własną publicznością. W lidze gospodarze, po bardzo słabym początku sezonu, zaczęli punktować. Wygrali jeden mecz i dwukrotnie zremisowali. Z kolei goście niedawno ulegli Eintrachtowi Frankfurt 0:1, a w poprzedniej kolejce bezbramkowo zremisowali z FC Schalke 04.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: 1. FC Union Berlin - 1. FC Köln

programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.
programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa

programme.desc: Po dziewięciu kolejkach Benfica traci już pięć oczek do liderującego w tabeli Porto. Orły nie mogą sobie zatem pozwolić na wpadkę w konfrontacji z Alvercą. W poprzedniej kampanii dwukrotnie ograły tego rywala 2:1.
programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: SL Benfica - FC Alverca

programme.desc: Lens znajduje się na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu w Ligue1. Przedłużenie dobrej passy nie będzie jednak dla wicemistrzów Francji łatwym zadaniem. W 9. kolejce podopieczni Dino Toppmöllera mierzą się bowiem z Lille, z którym poprzednim razem przegrali wysoko 0:3.
programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Lille OSC - RC Lens

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Juventus FC - SSC Napoli

programme.desc: FC Porto, mimo słabych wyników w europejskich pucharach, imponuje formą w krajowej lidze, gdzie ma na koncie komplet dziewięciu zwycięstw. Ostatnio Smoki pokonały na wyjeździe Gil Vicente 1:0, a w najbliższym spotkaniu zmierzą się u siebie z ostatnim w tabeli GD Estoril Praia.
programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: FC Porto - GD Estoril Praia

programme.title: Najszybsze gole Bundesligi

programme.desc: Ostatnie zwycięstwa nad Juventusem i Venezią pozwoliły Genui oddalić się od strefy spadkowej na dystans pięciu punktów. W meczu z Lecce Gryfy postarają się wykonać kolejny krok w kierunku utrzymanie w elicie.
programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: US Lecce - Genoa CFC

programme.desc: Zarówno Eintracht Frankfurt, jak i Hamburger SV zanotowały w poprzedniej kolejce porażki. Eintracht uległ 0:1 Borussii Dortmund, natomiast HSV musiał uznać wyższość Paderborn (0:1). Obie ekipy z pewnością postarają się wrócić na zwycięską ścieżkę, co zapowiada wyrównane starcie.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Eintracht Frankfurt - Hamburger SV

programme.desc: Strasbourg jest największym rozczarowaniem tej części sezonu. W lidze zdołał wygrać zaledwie 2 spotkania i znajduje się w strefie spadkowej. Dodatkowo na zwycięstwo czeka od 6 września. Przełamać się i tym samym opuścić ostatnie lokaty spróbuje starciem z Auxerre. Zadanie to będzie jednak bardzo trudne. Po fatalnym starcie podopieczni Willa Stilla obudzili się i w ciągu 5 kolejek zdobyli 10 punktów, tym samym zbliżając się do środka stawki.
programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: RC Strasbourg - AJ Auxerre

programme.desc: Twórcy przypominają historyczny sezon Werderu zakończony zdobyciem podwójnej korony: mistrzostwa Bundesligi i Pucharu Niemiec. W rozgrywkach 2003/2004 trenerem zespołu z Bremy był Thomas Schaaf. Zielono-białe barwy reprezentowali wówczas m.in. Angelos Charisteas,Christian Schulz i Frank Baumann.
programme.title: Werder Double

programme.desc: Biografie najlepszych obrońców lat 90., którzy trwale zapisali się w historii niemieckiej ekstraklasy. Widzowie poznają życiorysy takich piłkarzy, jak: Mike Werner, Lothar Matthäus, Thomas Helmer, Matthias Sammer czy Jens Nowotny.
programme.title: Najlepsi obrońcy Bundesligi lat 90

programme.desc: Sporting w poprzedniej kolejce niespodziewanie uległ Academico Viseu 1:2, tym samym powiększając swoją stratę do liderującego Porto do 9 punktów. Kolejne potknięcie nie tylko po raz kolejny oddali go od mistrzostwa, ale także może zrzucić go z ligowego podium. Uniknąć tego spróbuje w rywalizacji z walczącą o utrzymanie Casa Pią.
programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Casa Pia AC - Sporting CP

programme.desc: Nie tak fani Troyes wyobrażali sobie powrót do Ligue 1. Po ośmiu kolejkach ich ulubieńcy znajdują się na przedostatnim miejscu w tabeli z zaledwie jednym zwycięstwem na koncie. Wydostać się ze strefy spadkowej mogą już w tej kolejce. Zmierzą się z Le Mans FC, które zajmuje ostatnią bezpieczną lokatę.
programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: ESTAC Troyes - Le Mans FC

programme.desc: Bologna Łukasza Skorupskiego w poprzedniej kolejce niespodziewanie pokonała AC Milan 4:2. Zwycięstwo z zespołem z Mediolanu pozwoliło jej na wskoczenie na 11. miejsce i tym samym znaczące oddalenie się od strefy spadkowej. Teraz jej celem jest przybliżenie się do lokat pozwalających na grę w europejskich pucharach. A dobrą okazję do tego będzie miała już w tej kolejce. Zmierzy się z Monzą, która od początku rozgrywek rozczarowuje. Wygrała zaledwie 2 spotkania i cały czas krąży nad ostatnimi pozycjami w lidze.

W kolejnym spotkaniu Hamburger SV zmierzy się u siebie z ostatnią w tabeli Borussią Mönchengladbach. programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.
programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica

programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.
programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa

programme.desc: Olympique Lyon to jeden z najsłynniejszych klubów we Francji. Jego złota era przypadła na pierwszą dekadę XXI wieku, kiedy to siedmiokrotnie sięgnął po mistrzostwo Ligue 1. Twórcy filmu przypominają tamte sukcesy i przedstawiają wyzwania obecnie stojące przed Les Gones.
programme.title: Olympique Lyon - Między legendą a teraźniejszością

programme.desc: Rzuty karne w piłce nożnej to ogromne emocje towarzyszące zarówno biorącym w nich udział piłkarzom, jak i obserwującym je kibicom. Szczęście, nerwy ze stali i umiejętności techniczne są potrzebne, by dobrze wykonywać rzuty karne. Umiejętność ta jest bardzo ważna, bo strzały z jedenastu metrów rozstrzygały o losach niejednego ważnego spotkania.
programme.title: Dramatyczne rzuty karne

programme.desc: FC Porto nadal może pochwalić się kompletem zwycięstw w lidze. Ma ich już na koncie 10, a w poprzednim meczu pokonało Estoril 4:0. O przedłużenie tej imponującej serii podopieczni Francesco Farioliego powalczą w 11. kolejce na wyjeździe z Vitorią SC.
programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Vitoria SC - FC Porto

programme.desc: Liga włoska - mecz: ACF Fiorentina - Juventus FC.
programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: ACF Fiorentina - Juventus FC

programme.desc: Werder Brema w ubiegły weekend przedłużył serię bez porażki, wygrywając 2:0 z TSG Hoffenheim. W najbliższej kolejce podopieczni Daniela Thioune zagrają na wyjeździe z VfB Stuttgart. Gospodarze również sięgnęli po trzy punkty w poprzedniej serii spotkań, pokonując 4:2 Bayer Leverkusen.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: VfB Stuttgart - Werder Brema

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Brock Swell Clark Little recorda, com orgulho, o seu destemido e divertido irmão, o falecido surfista profissional, Brock Little, antes de filmar o evento em Memória de Eddie Aikau, a principal prova profissional de surf de ondas grandes em Oahu...
programme.title: Shorebreak

programme.desc: S7 E1 — We Got Dane Uma humorada e realista abordagem das aventuras e desventuras de Greg Browning, Donavon Frankenreiter, Tim Curran e Shawn 'Barney' Baron numa viagem de autocaravana ao longo da costa da Califórnia.
programme.title: Drive Thru USA

Com a participação de talentosos e divertidos surfistas locais, como Bobby Martinez...
programme.title: Drive Thru USA

programme.desc: S1 E9 — Baja Shannon e Shayne vão em viagem até Baja e quase que são atropelados por um búfalo em fúria.
programme.title: On Surfari

programme.desc: S1 E10 — Sumba Shannon e Shayne exploram a pequena ilha de Sumba, na Indonésia, descobrem a ajuda humanitária que se faz no local e ainda há tempo para um desporto medieval, costume e tradição da terra.
programme.title: On Surfari

programme.title: Camp Woodward

programme.desc: S3 E10 — Shredabago Neste episódio, Jeff King e a sua equipa fazem umas férias em família ao estilo "Built To Shred". Não percam os atletas Nilton Nieves, Chris Troy, Aldren Garcia, Adrian Mallory e Chad Knight em ação.
programme.title: Built To Shred

programme.title: Built To Shred

programme.desc: S5 E2 — Kazu Kazuhiro Kokubo, também conhecido como Kazu, viaja até ao Lago Tahoe para filmar com a Standard Crew nas melhores zonas de neve e dar os maiores saltos em Hemsedal na Noruega.
programme.title: The Standard Snowboard Show

programme.title: The Standard Snowboard Show

programme.desc: S4 E9 — A Day In Munich Danny Kass, Louie Vito e Eero Ettala viajam pela Alemanha e provocam o caos num autocarro turístico. Eero dedica-se a novos penteados e a equipa compra a indumentária típica da região para a prática de surf.
programme.title: The Adventures of Danny & The Dingo

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Die Zeit der Entdeckungen Diesmal geht es um die explorativen Reisen des Christopher Kolumbus. Das Ergebnis war ungeahnt. Durch seine fortlaufenden Reiseaktivitäten wurden Kontinente wieder miteinander verbunden, die vorher durch Erdbewegungen getrennt waren.
programme.title: Deep Time History

programme.desc: S1 — TNT und LSD Als der Schweizer Chemiker Albert Hofmann an einem Kreislaufmedikament forscht, entdeckt er zufällig LSD. Ein deutscher Chemiker hingegen will eigentlich einen Farbstoff herstellen, doch es entsteht hochexplosives TNT.
programme.title: Geniale Zufälle

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Der Strichcode Barcodes haben den globalen Handel radikal verändert und dazu beigetragen, den Aufstieg von riesigen Unternehmen wie Walmart bis hin zu Weltmächten wie China voranzutreiben, und alles begann mit einem Mann, der 1949 an einem Strand träumte.
programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis

programme.desc: S1 E81 — Blockchain - die Krypto-Datenbank Die Dokumentation behandelt das Betrugsrisiko im Umgang mit Kryptowährungen im Internet. Die Transaktionen lassen sich zwar über eine Blockchain-Datenbank nachvollziehen, aber die Identität der User ist dabei häufig nicht aufzuklären.
programme.title: Bright Now

programme.desc: S1 E58 — Alarm: Wälder in Flammen! Die Sendung erklärt, wie die Geschichte der Waldbewirtschaftung und der Verlust des öffentlichen Vertrauens in Verbindung mit dem Klimawandel dazu geführt haben, dass fast das ganze Jahr über riesige Brände in den USA ausgelöst werden.
programme.title: Breakthrough

programme.desc: Germany, 1945. A nation faces up to the ruins of its past. Hunger and adversity shape daily life. What lengths did people go to? Over two episodes, Crime in Post-War Germany explores this transitional phase in German history by using the examples of individual, particularly serious criminal cases. Criminal psychologists and forensics experts go in search of traces.
programme.title: Crime in Post-War Germany

programme.desc: Discover how a Soviet Intelligence officer avoided WWIII.

programme.desc: Discover how and why several brilliant scientists divulged the secrets of the atomic bomb.
programme.title: The A-Bomb Spies

programme.desc: America and Europe in 1491, and why America was discovered and not the other way around.
programme.title: Part 1

programme.desc: The true legacy of Columbus is biological, and it created one world out of two.
programme.title: Part 2

programme.desc: More than 2000 years ago the Maya built gigantic cities in the middle of the jungle of Central America. They were brilliant inventors and set standards in writing, mathematics and astronomy.
programme.title: The Maya

programme.desc: The Aztecs: Within a very short time they created a huge empire, whose metropolis was a perfectly organized floating garden city on the Mexican plateau.
programme.title: The Aztecs

programme.desc: The Incas appear out of nowhere and within a few decades their empire develops into the largest empire in the world at the time.
programme.title: The Incas

programme.desc: To many, Columbus is the man who discovered America. Yet, there had been others before him. This is their story!
programme.title: First Before Columbus

programme.desc: A German-Egyptian team is looking for traces of the largest temple of the pharaohs in the middle of Cairo and for answers as to why the sanctuary was abandoned more than 2000 years ago.
programme.title: Heliopolis - The City of the Sun

programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.
programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World

programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.
programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World

programme.desc: When an injury sidelines Allen, he stays at the shop while Ton takes Big Sis to the auction and goes rogue, ignoring Allen's advice and making risky purchases that could lose the partners a boatload of cash.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Catch My Drift?
programme.desc: The guys land a custom drift car and a luxury antiques unit that could have a one-of-a-kind pilot pistol from WWI. While trying to track down the provenance of the gun, Ton's lead foot gets them into trouble at their car sale.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Whiskey Business
programme.desc: An auction in Allen's old stomping grounds triggers memories of being a "lone wolf." The guys find a set of RC race boats and when they buy a man-cave unit full of old whiskey, a night of partying leads to some tough sales.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hall of Fame Game
programme.desc: Allen heads to an auction with Elle, while Ton and Big Sis revamp the shop to help bring in more customers. Allen unearths a Ouija board and a set of antique basketballs, and goes toe-to-toe with an NBA Hall of Famer.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks
programme.desc: Military-grade Tomahawk cruise missile jet engine; century-old handcrafted wild west cowboy saddle; 1960s high roller's gold money.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Party Gras

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' ser vi tilbage på sæsonen med Nicolai Vallys og Mathias Greve. Hør deres egne ord om højdepunkter, udfordringer og oplevelserne i Brøndby IF-trøjen gennem en intens og mindeværdig Superliga-sæson.

programme.title: Dokumentar
programme.desc: Kom helt tæt på trænerteamet i 29 intense og fokuserede dage, når Superliga-truppen gøres klar til forårspremieren. Oplev forberedelserne, beslutningerne og pulsen bag kulisserne, hvor hver detalje tæller frem mod den første kamp.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Martin Retov sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som først bød på en årrække som spiller og siden som træner.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Mogens Krogh sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

programme.title: Spørg Løs!
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spørg Løs!' afslører spillerne, hvem der ville vinde Tour de France, hvem de ville stemme på som statsminister – og hvem der er bedst i et køkken. Du får også deres bud på yndlingsmusik, idoler og drømme uden for fodbolden.

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'All Access' kommer du med bag kulisserne til opgøret i Viborg og sejrene i Aarhus og Silkeborg. Oplev intensiteten, stemningen og de afgørende øjeblikke, når Brøndby jagter point på tre svære udebaner i Superligaen.

programme.title: Sportsdirektørerne
programme.desc: I andet afsnit af Sportsdirektørerne fortsætter fortællingerne fra direktionsgangen på Vestegnen, hvor der reflekteres over store beslutninger, særlige øjeblikke og den evige tilknytning til Brøndby IF.

programme.title: Quizhjørnet
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Quizhjørnet' står den på EM-special og spillet 'Kend Din Holdkammerat'. Spillerne tester deres viden om hinanden og landsholdets store scene – med masser af grin, overraskelser og kamp om håneretten.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' møder du de nye forsvarsspillere Rasmus Lauritsen og Frederik Winther, hører Thomas Mikkelsen sætte ord på rollen som erfaren sidste skanse – og følger Joe Bells rejse og refleksioner i Brøndby-trøjen.

programme.title: Reservemålmændene
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Reservemålmændene' følger vi livet som målmand i skyggen af førstevalget. Hør om ankomsten til Brøndby IF, rollen som reserve og de største oplevelser – fortalt af dem, der altid er klar, men sjældent i rampelyset.

programme.title: Quizhjørnet

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du Oscar Schwartau i 'Drengene fra Vestegnen'. Hør om rejsen fra ungdomsårene til gennembruddet i Superligaen – og hvad det betyder at repræsentere Brøndby IF som en af klubbens egne.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Ole Bjur sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' følger du Henrik Heggheims rejse fra Stavanger til Brøndby IF. Hør om overgangen til dansk fodbold, tilværelsen på Vestegnen og de oplevelser, der har formet ham som spiller og menneske i den gule trøje.

programme.title: Dokumentar
programme.desc: Oplev et følelsesladet og nostalgisk tilbageblik på mesterskabet, ingen troede muligt. Hør historierne bag sæsonen, der kulminerede i Brøndby IF’s første triumf i 16 år – fortalt af dem, der selv var med til at skrive historien.

programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Legenden Fortæller' ser vi tilbage på Bent 'Turbo' Christensen Arensøes målrige karriere i Brøndby IF. Med fem mesterskaber, to pokaltitler og tre topscorertitler skrev han sig ind i historien – både som spiller og træner.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: I sæsonpremieren af 'Legenden Fortæller' ser vi tilbage på Kim Vilforts 12 år i Brøndby IF – fra præsentationen i 1986 til den sidste kamp i 1998. Hør om de største kampe, titlerne og øjeblikkene, der gjorde ham til en af klubbens største profiler.

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'All Access' kommer du helt tæt på den intense derbysejr og med bag kulisserne til kampen i Aalborg, hvor du oplever stemningen, forberedelserne og øjeblikkene, der definerede to af sæsonens mest nervepirrende opgør.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du drengene fra Vestegnen, Clement Bischoff og Noah Nartey. Hør om deres rødder, vejen gennem ungdomsrækkerne og stoltheden ved at spille for Brøndby IF – klubben, de er vokset op med.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Morten Wieghorst sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

programme.desc: Mecze Bayernu z Borussią Dortmund od lat nadają ton rywalizacji o mistrzostwo Niemiec. Nie inaczej będzie z Der Klassikerem numer 141, który zostanie rozegrany w ramach ósmej kolejki kampanii 2026/27. Bawarczycy i piłkarze BVB do połowy października szli łeb w łeb w wyścigu o tytuł. Ich bezpośrednie starcie na Allianz Arenie najprawdopodobniej zadecyduje o tym, który z gigantów zostanie samodzielnym liderem Bundesligi. Podopieczni Vincenta Kompany'ego mają nad Dortmundczykami przewagę psychologiczną. Znajdują się bowiem na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu nad Borussią. Ostatnim razem pokonali ją 2:1 w sierpniowym meczu o Superpuchar Niemiec.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: FC Bayern Monachium - Borussia Dortmund

programme.desc: Rossoneri znaleźli patent na derbowego rywala. Mogą się poszczycić bilansem pięciu wygranych i trzech remisów w ośmiu ostatnich konfrontacjach z Interem. Podrażnieni Nerazzurri mają świadomość, że muszą zrobić wszystko, co w ich mocy, by przerwać błędne koło i odzyskać panowanie w stolicy Lombardii. W hicie dziesiątej kolejki na pewno zmotywuje ich do tego spory ścisk panujący na szczycie tabeli Serie A. Jeśli Piotr Zieliński i spółka nie pokonają Milanu, ucieszą piłkarzy Lazio i Romy, którzy na obecnym etapie sezonu wyglądają na ich głównych konkurentów w wyścigu o scudetto.
programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Milan - Inter Mediolan

programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.
programme.title: AJ Auxerre - Małe miasto, wielki klub
